title: Snake Man: Gear 4!!!!
author: swavecito
desc:
Snake Man: Gear 4 is a 12-week athletic powerbuilding program inspired by the moment Luffy stops relying on brute force alone and shifts into speed, angles, pressure, and relentless adaptation.

Built around three full-body lift days, the program develops chest strength, leg mass, back thickness, side-delt width, arm detail, and overall power. Heavy top sets build the force. Back-off volume builds the muscle. Athletic work, Zone 2 cardio, and aggressive conditioning build the engine behind it.

The spirit of the program is Snakeman in the Mirror World: stay elastic, stay sharp, keep changing angles, and build enough stamina to keep attacking when the pace rises. Like Jet Culverin, the goal is controlled power that keeps accelerating. Like Black Mamba, it is about repeat output. Like King Cobra, it is about finishing strength.

This is for the powerbuilder-athlete — bigger, stronger, faster, better conditioned, and harder to read.
